description: This is a CMake module script for the 'compile_aidl' function, used to generate source code from AIDL files during build time. It sets up and runs the AIDL compiler with specified options, supporting different languages and include directories.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a function that wraps the invocation of the AIDL compiler with configurable parameters such as source files, compiler binary path, flags, language, include directories, and target directory.
